pipeline.titulo: From facial recognition to a Telegram notification, with nobody in the loop.

pasos.detalle: The browser captures a frame every 500 ms and sends it to the facial-recognition service on the VPS.
The service identifies the student, stores the 128-dimension encoding and writes the record to MongoDB.
The Telegram bot automatically notifies the parent the moment the system detects the student's arrival.

proyectos.bajada: The problem and the outcome stay visible. The technical detail opens if you want it.

lista.titulo: Academic Management System — Colegio Juan Velasco Alvarado
lista.cliente: Private school in Peru · built entirely by me
lista.problema: The school kept enrollment, grades, schedules and attendance in scattered spreadsheets, and every message to a parent depended on someone remembering to call.
lista.resultado: One system in production: admins manage enrollment and sections, teachers record grades and attendance, the camera recognizes the student on arrival, and the parent gets a Telegram notification with nobody in the loop.
modulos: Admin panel: users, students, enrollment, sections and academic terms
Teacher panel: grade entry, attendance control and weekly schedule
Biometric attendance: the browser streams frames to the recognition service and the record is written automatically
Parent notification bot: automatic Telegram message on detected arrival
Grade lookup bot for teachers: PIN authentication and an AI Agent with tool calling
System help bot: replaces the static manual and accepts voice questions (Whisper)
Parent linking bot: ID verification before notifications are enabled
lista.arquitectura: Modular architecture with domain, application, infrastructure and presentation kept apart (students, attendance, grades, enrollment, schedules, telegram and eight more modules). Facial recognition lives outside the app: the browser captures a frame every 500 ms and posts it to the VPS service, which returns the identified student and stores the 128-dimension encoding against MongoDB.

lista.problema: Studying long material with nobody to quiz you: rereading it never tells you whether you actually understood it.
lista.resultado: An installable PWA where the admin uploads the material and the AI generates questions from that material, grades the answer instantly and tracks each user's consumption with an alert as the limit approaches.
modulos: Question generation with OpenAI in JSON mode, validated with Zod before it reaches the user
Instant grading with feedback, without revealing the answer at generation time
Admin panel: users, roles, expiry, usage limits and Markdown material upload
Single active session per user, bcrypt hashing and rate limiting at 5 attempts per 15 minutes
Installable as a PWA with its own manifest and icons
lista.arquitectura: Next.js with route handlers protected by role-aware middleware, Supabase as the database with an atomic function for the usage counter, and NextAuth with custom credentials.

lista.problema: Almost nobody can prove their automations exist: they stay inside the client's account and you have to take their word for it.
lista.resultado: I published the flows with every token replaced by placeholders, each with its README and diagram. You can import them into your own n8n and see exactly how they work.
modulos: Real-estate quoting bot — client in Mexico: walks the salesperson through 14 steps, computes amounts by payment plan and returns a finished PDF (including a variant that accepts voice notes)

Instagram analytics pipeline — for an anchor account with 95K+ followers: 400+ historical posts, metrics by hour, day and content type, and semantic caption analysis (topic, hook, emotion, narrative structure)
KARLANT · medical reports — radiology report drafts generated with GPT-4o and inserted into the Google Docs template, with state tracking to avoid duplicates
KARLANT · SIGEPS — bulk PDF download from a government health portal with Playwright, session validation, per-row error handling and Drive sync
School bot system — the four flows from the project above, also published
lista.arquitectura: The node counts and technologies on this page are not hand-written: they are read from these very JSON files at build time and the badges are derived from each node's type field.

lista.problema: Selling PDFs and subscriptions without a system means charging by hand and emailing the file, one customer at a time.
lista.resultado: A bilingual site where payment triggers delivery: the webhook confirms the purchase and the buyer receives the download link, with the file in private storage served through a proxy that authorizes server-side.
modulos: Stripe with Payment Links, automatic delivery webhooks and recurring subscriptions, plus PayPal
Private Vercel Blob storage and a download proxy with server-side authorization
Transactional email with Resend on the site's own domain (DKIM, SPF, MX)
Full SEO: canonical, hreflang, JSON-LD schema and llms.txt for AI crawlers
lista.arquitectura: Astro with minimal islands so the content stays static HTML, and Tailwind v4 with custom tokens.

lista.titulo: L'Atelier d'Ana — home bakery with WhatsApp ordering
lista.cliente: Home bakery in Lima · built entirely by me
lista.problema: Ana baked to order but had no digital menu: every order meant explaining the full menu and prices over chat, one by one.
lista.resultado: A catalog with the full menu, prices in soles, and a direct WhatsApp button per product — the customer sees the menu, picks what they want, and orders without back-and-forth.
modulos: Product catalog filterable by category (Classics, Specials, Premium)
Per-product card with description, price in soles, and a direct WhatsApp button
"About Ana" section and customer reviews
Fully static site, no backend or database
lista.arquitectura: Astro with Tailwind and minimal client-side JavaScript — the menu and prices are static content, and the order button is a plain WhatsApp link with no automation behind it.

negocio.titulo: What I automate is usually what eats someone's whole day on your team.
negocio.bajada: Four real cases, with the before and after that stayed running.

lista.delta: from a full afternoon → minutes on Telegram
lista.antes: The salesperson opens a template, works out the down payment and installments for each payment plan and builds the PDF. Every quote eats part of the afternoon and any distraction becomes a wrong number.
lista.despues: They answer 14 questions on Telegram and the bot returns the PDF already calculated and formatted. Quoting happens from a phone, in front of the client.
lista.prueba: Delivered to a real-estate developer in Mexico

lista.delta: from writing it all → reviewing and signing
lista.antes: Every radiology report is written in full even though the structure never changes: technique, findings, conclusion.
lista.despues: The draft arrives generated inside the Google Docs template and the doctor reviews and signs. The system marks what was already processed so no study is repeated.

lista.delta: from one by one → automatic batches
lista.antes: Someone logs into the government health portal, looks up each record and downloads the PDF by hand, session after session.
lista.despues: A Playwright flow validates the session, downloads in batches, handles errors row by row and leaves everything organized in Drive.
lista.prueba: Automation in production against the SIGEPS portal

lista.delta: from one person answering all day → bots 24/7
lista.antes: Teachers and parents call or text about grades, attendance and how to use the system; there is always someone answering the same thing.
lista.despues: Authenticated Telegram bots answer with real system data: grades behind a PIN for teachers, live attendance for parents, and system help by text or voice.
lista.prueba: Four bots in production in the school system
